tasks.subject: Task 1: CsNetwork anchors, ties, error components
tasks.description:

**Files:**

- Modify: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-21-loop-closure-adjustment-design.md` (totalCorrection -> rmsShift)
- Test: `tests/js_unit.js` (Network section, after the disconnected-components block near line 515)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] resolve() returns `anchors`, the station names placed with no parent, in placement order
- [ ] every closures[i] and loops[i] carries `horizontal` and `vertical` beside distance/error
- [ ] percent keeps its existing 3D-over-slope-length definition (existing assertions unchanged)
- [ ] a leg joining two separately-anchored components gets kind 'tie', lands in resolved.ties, and is NOT in loops
- [ ] CsValidate raises no loop-misclosure finding for a tie
- [ ] the spec's summary table says rmsShift, not totalCorrection

**Verify:** `node tests/js_unit.js` -> `### UNIT OK <n> assertions`, n up by 14

**Steps:**

- Add mis.horizontal / mis.vertical in the haveFrom && haveTo branch

- Add horizontal/vertical to describeLoop's return
- Update the resolve doc comment (closures, loops, ties, anchors, kind values)
- Run to green; patch the spec's field name; commit

tasks.subject: Task 2: CsAdjust.js least-squares solver
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A pure Core module that takes a survey and its raw resolve result and returns a resolved-shaped object with adjusted coordinates, per-station shifts, per-leg residuals, and a summary.

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsAdjust.js`
- Modify: `scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsAll.js` (include after CsNetwork.js)
- Modify: `tests/js_unit.js` (CORE_FILES after CsNetwork.js; new Adjust test section)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] the hand-computed square with equal weights puts +0.125 on each of the four loop legs and 0 on the branch leg
- [ ] the pinned anchor does not move; y and z do not move when the misclosure is purely in x
- [ ] a loopless (tree) survey is returned unchanged in zero iterations
- [ ] two fixed stations both land exactly on their given coordinates
- [ ] a noAdjust leg keeps its surveyed geometry while neighbours absorb the error
- [ ] closures and loops come back identical to the input's -- as-surveyed
- [ ] CsGrade.compute fed the adjusted result returns the same grade and reasoning as from the raw result
- [ ] adjusting an already-adjusted survey moves nothing
- [ ] a starved solve returns converged:false, adjusted:false, raw:null and raw coordinates

**Verify:** `node tests/js_unit.js` -> `### UNIT OK <n>`, n up by 28; then `./tests/run_all.sh` -> ALL TESTS PASSED

**Steps:**
- Write the 28 failing assertions using EQ = {sigmaTape:1, sigmaAngle:0} against the existing square fixture
- Register CsAdjust.js in tests/js_unit.js CORE_FILES and in Core/CsAll.js
- Run to see red (ENOENT on the missing file)
- Write CsAdjust.js: legVariance, median, extentOf, solve (Jacobi-preconditioned CG, matrix-free), unadjusted, adjust
- Run node tests, then ./tests/run_all.sh, then commit

tasks.subject: Task 1b: fixed control follows the anchor's frame
tasks.description:
**Goal:** When a survey has two or more fixed stations and the caller passes an explicit anchor, pin the other fixed stations at their control coordinates translated into the anchor's frame, so real control disagreement surfaces as a tie instead of being silently discarded.

**Files:**
- Modify: `scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsNetwork.js` (resolve: frame-aware seedFixed)
- Modify: `scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsDraw.js` (no Fixed tag that contradicts the drawn position)
- Modify: `scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsReport.js` (report the offset, or which stations were not honored)
- Test: `tests/js_unit.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] with an explicit anchor whose station is itself fixed, other fixed stations pin at control + (anchorPos - anchoredStationControl)
- [ ] the tie misclosure equals the one the same survey reports with no anchor -- a pure translation cannot change the measured disagreement
- [ ] with an explicit anchor whose station has no control, behavior is unchanged and the report says which fixed stations were not honored and why
- [ ] a survey with 0 or 1 fixed stations is byte-identical to today on every path
- [ ] CsDraw never writes Fixed=<coords> on a station drawn elsewhere
- [ ] the applied offset is reported once, in drawing units

**Verify:** ./tests/run_all.sh -> ALL TESTS PASSED

**Steps:**
- Write the failing assertions from the acceptance criteria, using the P1/P2/Q1/Q2 two-component fixture plus a same-component variant
- Implement frame-aware seeding: offset = anchorPos - fixed[anchorName], applied to every other fixed station; fall back to today when the anchored station has no control
- Stop CsDraw writing a Fixed tag that contradicts the drawn position
- Report the offset, or the un-honored stations
- Run the full suite; commit

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsNetwork.js", "scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsDraw.js", "scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsReport.js", "tests/js_unit.js"], "verifyCommand": "./tests/run_all.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["frame-offset control pinning", "tie misclosure invariant under the frame shift", "unchanged with 0 or 1 fixed stations", "no contradictory Fixed tag", "offset reported"], "modelTier": "deep"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1c: bridge classifier cost + path honesty
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Fix the two blocking findings from the Task 1 code-quality review (quadratic bridge classifier; two-root path fabricating a nonexistent adjacency), plus ties carrying a meaningless percent and self-loops being scored as 100%-blown loops.

**Files:**
- Modify: `scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsNetwork.js`
- Test: `tests/js_unit.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] bridge test runs only for shots that resolve as closures -- O(k*m), k = closure count
- [ ] 4,000-shot survey resolves well under 100ms under node, asserted as a loose upper bound
- [ ] classifier verdicts unchanged on every existing fixture (performance change, not behavior)
- [ ] two-root circuit no longer implies a nonexistent adjacency; path join semantics documented and machine-detectable
- [ ] .path contents asserted for single-root AND two-root cases
- [ ] ties carry percent: null, and no consumer formats it
- [ ] a from === to shot is SKIPPED, not scored (Compass zero-length LRUD carriers are real data)
- [ ] a direct double tie between two fixed anchors is tested

**Verify:** ./tests/run_all.sh -> ALL TESTS PASSED

**Steps:**
- Measure the current cost first and record the baseline
- Move the bridge test to run lazily for closure candidates only; memoize
- Re-run every existing fixture to prove verdicts unchanged
- Add viaControl (or equivalent) so the control join is detectable; document path semantics
- Null the percent on ties; skip from === to in the usable filter
- Add the missing .path and double-tie assertions, plus the timing bound
- Full suite; commit

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsNetwork.js", "tests/js_unit.js"], "verifyCommand": "./tests/run_all.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["closure-only bridge test", "4000 shots under 100ms", "verdicts unchanged", "no fabricated adjacency", "path asserted", "tie percent null", "self-loop skipped"], "modelTier": "deep"}
```
